operation: Hashing the contents of the existing owner lock file
interpretation: Windows denied reading the lock range. This alone was not reported as proof of a healthy sender lock.
change: The check now uses metadata before/after and an existing rb handle for a nonblocking exclusive lock probe; it does not read or write the lock contents, unlock another process, construct a UsageManager, or recover/reserve any production attempt.
additionalDiagnostic: The restricted shell also denied the optional CIM process inventory; the report will not claim the lock owner's process identity was verified.
